title: The Big Match
lines: Ben and Meg set up a pitching match.
They stand at the edge of the bridge.
Ben pitches a small ball to Meg.
Meg catches it and pitches it back.
Then Ben pitches it into the ditch.
Meg grabs at the ball, but it is stuck.
Ben gets a long stick from the grass.
Meg tugs the ball up with the stick.
The wet ball drips mud on the grass.
Then the big match goes on and on.
Mom hands them a badge and some fudge.

questions.ask: Where did the ball land when Ben pitched it to Meg the second time?
questions.listenFor: In the ditch. Line five says it — point them at that line rather than saying it for them.

questions.ask: How did the ball get out of the ditch?
questions.listenFor: Ben got a long stick from the grass and Meg tugged the ball up with it. If they say "Meg grabbed it," ask "did that work?"

questions.ask: Which part of the match did you like best? Read me that line.
questions.listenFor: Any line. Reading it back keeps the pick tied to the page rather than to a guess.
